news.headline: Saints beat Cowboys 27-24 on a last-minute kick
news.summary: Daniel Carlson made a 53-yard field goal with under a minute left Friday night in Arlington. All three kickers competing for the job kicked in the game, which closed out the preseason.

news.headline: Three kickers still fighting for the Saints job
news.summary: Tanner Brown made all eight of his field goal tries at Wednesday's practice, while Charlie Smyth and Daniel Carlson each missed one. Coach Kellen Moore says he wants to see them kick in Friday's game at Dallas before he picks one.

news.headline: Saints will rest starters in Friday game at Dallas
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said most of the starters will not play in the last preseason game at Dallas on Friday night. They already got their work in during three joint practices with the Cowboys.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall named Philo his starting quarterback on Monday. Philo transferred in from Georgia Tech and beat out Tramell Jones Jr. for the job.

news.headline: Myles Graham makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Florida linebacker Myles Graham was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, given to college football's best defensive player. He led the Gators with 76 tackles last season.

news.headline: Five Gators make Senior Bowl watch list
news.summary: Kamran James, Eric Singleton Jr., Bryce Thornton, Jadan Baugh and Myles Graham were named to the Senior Bowl's preseason top 300 list. It is an early sign that pro scouts will be watching them this fall.

news.headline: Judge puts the SEC's new player rule on hold
news.summary: A judge in Texas ruled Thursday that the SEC cannot enforce its new ban on former pro players joining college teams. LSU has two former pro players who want to play there this season.

news.headline: SEC will suspend coaches who sign pro players
news.summary: A school that adds a former pro player now loses its head coach for half a season and pays a large fine. The 15 other SEC schools voted for the penalties and LSU did not vote.

news.headline: Players add the SEC commissioner to their lawsuit
news.summary: The two former pro players who want to join LSU have now named SEC commissioner Greg Sankey in their court case. A judge in Baton Rouge hears the case Monday.

news.headline: Zeon Chriss-Gremillion will start at quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall picked Chriss-Gremillion to start Tulane's opener at Duke on September 5. He has started 13 college games, first at Louisiana and then at Houston.

news.headline: Two quarterbacks lead the way in last scrimmage
news.summary: Kadin Semonza and Zeon Chriss-Gremillion took most of the first-team snaps in Tulane's final scrimmage on Saturday at Yulman Stadium. Coach Will Hall said he will name his starting quarterback on Monday.

news.headline: Jack Tchienchou makes top defender watch list
news.summary: Tulane safety Jack Tchienchou was named to the watch list for the Bednarik Award, which goes to the best defensive player in college football. He led Tulane with 83 tackles last season.
